say:1:1028322001:1.text: We've tried everything, but can't seem to wake him up. What are we going to do?
say:1:1028322001:1.source_cn: 我们试了这么多种方法都叫不醒伽利，现在要怎么办？

say:2:1028322002:1.text: He can't keep sleeping like this...
say:2:1028322002:1.source_cn: 总不能让他一直这么睡下去……

say:3:1028322003:1.text: Perhaps I can find some help. I'm not sure where Master Arden is at the moment, but... Oh, I just remembered the kind old man in Ivoryshade!
say:3:1028322003:1.source_cn: 或许可以找人问问，不知道雅顿老爷子现在在哪里……等等，...

say:4:1028322004:1.text: He was very good at gathering herbs and mixing teas and made a point of telling us about the complex properties of these plants...
say:4:1028322004:1.source_cn: 他很擅长采集草药和配置花茶，还特地跟我们说这些植物的药...

say:5:1028322005:1.text: With Misarte's blessing, hopefully, he'll know how to deal with this.
say:5:1028322005:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒保佑，没准他知道些什么？

say:6:1028322006:1.text: Ivoryshade? I want to visit this old man in person!
say:6:1028322006:1.source_cn: 月影乡？拜托你们，我……我想亲自去拜访这位老人，求求你们了！

say:7:1028322007:1.text: Look... I know you mean no harm, but the people of Ivoryshade are still mistrusting of outsiders.
say:7:1028322007:1.source_cn: 这……我们知道你并不是坏人，但月影乡的人恐怕不会相信外人。
